description: This file defines structures, enums, and classes related to managing TLS pinning and TLS session handling with a focus on secure fingerprint storage, validation, and WebSocket session configuration.

classes.name: GatewayTLSPinningSession
classes.description: Manages WebSocket sessions with custom TLS challenge handling based on fingerprint verification

methods.name: loadFingerprint
methods.description: Loads a stored TLS fingerprint associated with a stable ID from keychain storage

methods.name: saveFingerprint
methods.description: Saves a TLS fingerprint to keychain storage associated with a stable ID

methods.name: clearFingerprint
methods.description: Removes a stored fingerprint for a given stable ID from keychain storage

methods.name: clearAllFingerprints
methods.description: Removes all stored fingerprints from keychain storage

methods.name: makeWebSocketTask
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket task with specified URL and configured maximum message size

methods.name: urlSession(_:didReceive:completionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles server trust challenges, verifies server certificate fingerprint against expected, and manages trust decisions
